title: Monarch CLI normalized transaction detail (v1)
description: Normative contract for single-transaction detail output (`monarch transactions get`). Extends the list record shape with requested/returned identity, redirect state, the original transaction, nested attachment/tag/split collections, and review attribution. Fields are always present; unavailable values are null. Optional additive properties such as `reviewed_at` and `reviewed_by_user` are also always emitted by the CLI and remain optional here only to preserve the additive compatibility classification. Additive-only: removing or renaming a property, narrowing nullability, tightening a type, or adding a required property requires a new schema version.

requested_id.description: The transaction ID the caller requested; echoed for requested-versus-returned observability.

redirected.description: True when the returned transaction ID differs from the requested ID.

original_transaction.description: Normalized upstream originalTransaction object, or null when not provided.

amount.description: Transaction amount; negative is an expense, positive is income.

description.description: Deterministic description: merchant.name, then plaidName, else null.

is_pending.description: True while the upstream transaction is pending.

review_status.description: Opaque upstream review status. The released detail query does not select this field (it selects reviewedAt/reviewedByUser instead), so it is always null in normalized detail and must be treated as a placeholder; use reviewed_at/reviewed_by_user for review attribution. The list query does select reviewStatus, so transaction:v1 list records may carry a value.

reviewed_at.description: Literal upstream reviewedAt timestamp, or null when unreviewed or omitted. Detail-only optional additive property always emitted by the CLI.

reviewed_by_user.description: Normalized upstream reviewedByUser relationship ({id, name}) or null when unavailable. Detail-only optional additive property always emitted by the CLI.

owner_id.description: Upstream ownedByUser.id, or null when no owner relationship was provided.

owner_name.description: Upstream ownedByUser.name, or null when no owner relationship was provided.

is_recurring.description: Upstream isRecurring flag; absent or null defaults to false.

hidden_from_reports.description: Upstream hideFromReports flag; absent or null defaults to false.

is_manual.description: Upstream isManual flag; absent or null defaults to false.

attachments.description: Normalized attachments; absent or null upstream containers normalize to [].

tags.description: Normalized tags; absent or null upstream containers normalize to [].

split.description: Split state and normalized split records; nested split-transaction containers never include unknown fields.

is_split.description: Upstream isSplitTransaction flag; absent or null defaults to false.

has_split_transactions.description: Upstream hasSplitTransactions flag; absent or null defaults to false.

splits.description: Normalized split records; absent or null upstream containers normalize to [].
